title: Specs mentioned not matching the product received
body:
I ordered this laptop from the Bramalea City Centre Best Buy store and received it yesterday.

My initial impression of the laptop itself is a mix of positive and doubtful. I have concerns about the accuracy of the product specifications listed on the website.

The bestbuy.ca product page and the sales representative indicated that the laptop includes a fingerprint sensor. After receiving and setting up the device, I was unable to locate a fingerprint reader on the unit.
The product page lists the processor as an Intel Core Ultra 7 365H. However, the processor reported by the system appears to be an Intel Core Ultra 7 356H.
I have also been unable to find detailed information for this exact model on HP's official website, making it difficult to verify the specifications independently.

At this point, I am still evaluating the laptop.
product_name: HP OmniBook X 16" Touchscreen 2-in-1 Laptop - Eclipse Grey (Intel Core Ultra 7-365H/32GB RAM/1TB SSD/Windows 11 Home)

title: This has exceeded expectations so far
body:
I've only had this for a few days, so far it has exceeded my expectations in everyway. The build quality is far better than i expected including the hinge design. It came with the HP pen in the box, something I was unsure of. I find computers frustrating and I've truly hated my windows ten pc since day 1 despite it being a high end unit at the time with rtx 1080 gpu and top end specs. There is nothing straightforward about any of it, from drivers to fixing errors, it was never easy and finding answers was often impossible. This is the better experience in just about every way.
 Windows 11 with the AI is a complete opposite of that experience. Everything transferred with zero fuss and there is zero issues with updates and no functionality issues, it has just worked. Its far more intuitive and less cluttered with crap you don't need and the A.I. chat can walk you through it the moment you run into issues. It makes the AI on my phone look like a toddler stumbling around in the dark.
   I also wasnt sure if the  tablet mode was going to work well with the pen, but its been easy to figure out, every step of the way. It recognizes almost chicken scratch writing with eass and the pop up box to write in was dead simple to figure out. It comes up when you tap on an area to write, if yiu make a mistske you just cross it out or press the button on the pen and it erases it, when you tap enter it dissappears, Its almost seamless. 
  During the setup you can connect your phone, wirelessly or by cable should you want. I have it connected wirelessly to my Samsung s23 ultra, it took about a minute to do so. My most important pictures from the last 10 plus yesrs are on it as well as other important videos and pdf's  The interface is intuitive and very well done,its no afterthought. Accessing pictures and 10 years of pdf downloads and files off of it through the interfsce is far easier than doing it so off my phone.
  The A.I. copilot has been far more useful than I imagined and I haven't even scratched the surface. You can use it offline and its been helping me organize all those pdf's into categories based on key words in them and pictures by people's face, plus my wood turning and metal working into seperate groups. I've wanted to do this for a decade but found it slow and frustrating on both pc and android phone. The A.I. assistance makes it easy. This is a giant leap for a person that had trouble downloading a document and finding it later. The same goes for connectivity to a wireless monitor, tv,  bluetooth earbuds and my printer is now a breeze, plus the great phone interface ss mentioned.
  The OLED screen looks great, it shows the deep blacks, the detail is fantastic and I can see more "in the shadows" when streaming a movie compared to the 1080p monitor I had been using. It isn't 4k but its an incredibly nice upgrade to what I had. 
  The 2 in 1 makes this a great buy in my opinion. Using it as a tablet while sitting in a chair or using it lying down with it in "tent" format on your lap is a game changer. I rarely used my laptop because I may as well just sit in front of my full sized pc with its larger monitor. 
  The same went for using my laptop in my small  shop thats jam packed with machines. There was never a good place to put. I'm just starting to learn g-code for a hobby cnc build as well as flashing firmware on a few machines. Its something I've started and stopped doing a half dozen times over the last year, I'm a hands on guy and have resisted learning g-code and basic coding because it frustrated the hell out of me. Wait for it, yes, there are A.I. tools to help you compile code based on simple instructions. The same goes for g-code. Its not perfect but you have an A.I. assistant to help explain every command at every step. I've just started and have a long way to go, it is finally making sense though and my frustration has been kept to a minimum.
  So far, I couldn't be happier with my purchase. The build quality is very premium, the new co'pilot with windows 11 has changed my opinion of windows computers completely.
  Using chat gpt, or the chrome browser A.I. on my phone was helpful and great for gathering technical and design information etc but its not on the same level and extremely limited by comparison. The errors and mistakes those made as well as the limits on what you can do with them and the diffuculty with retrieving all that information later made them very frustrating, very quickly. With the co-pilot you can save, organize and turn your a.i. searches into useful documents and integrate the a.i. into the tasks your doing. You can comeback anytime and continue that conversation, as you make an actual useful reference document from it.  I haven't even used the Microsoft 365 with its co-pilot  it offets far more capabilities so you can compile many pdf's at one time in what looks like an even more intuitive way.  Its the next step to making the hundreds of pdf newsletters and technical articles I have into one, organized and catorigized condensed reference document. 
  I wasn't sure if the A.I. in these were going to be a novelty, or a useful tool. Now I know. Creating, saving, finding and converting document formats is finally easy. Windows 11 is a nice upgrade and easier to use, by leaps and bounds for the somewhat computer illiterate, the A.I. teaches you what to do and guides the way, it makes the experience far more intuitive. I haven't gotten lost or stumped yet. 
  This processor, 32gb ram and 1 tb ssd will ensure I can run my design, coding and slicing software for years to come, with ease. If your considering a 2 in 1 format, for $1999 (on sale), its an incredible value. The nest closest onmibook I found had decent specifications, but was a 2024 release. This is a brand new 2026 release.  You won't find better specifications in this price range and if your on the fence, remember that a large price increase are coming on the next model releases and the base prices are going up by hundreds of dollars on everything.  Even the Ryzen processor equivalent (slightly better at gaming with its higher core integrated graphics) is already $1000 more than this. I doubt a better deal from a reputable source will be found this year. You'll likely be waiting until this time next year to get a better deal on this equivalent 2 in 1 laptop when they clear them out for the new models. I did a lot of research before parting with my money and I'm very happy that I bought this 2 in 1, a laptop, It would have been very disappointing  using another laptop after using this!

title: Great Laptop
body: Got this on sale about a week ago and is exceeding expectations. Build quality is really good and has very good specs with a powerful processor. Was able to run Elden ring at 1080p medium settings at close to 60 fps which is really surprising for an integrated gpu. OLED display looks great. It’s definitely a larger laptop so if you’re looking for portability this might not be for you. But all the other considerations like specs, 2 in 1 features, and overall build quality make up for the weight and size for me.
